meta.title: WacChat – Real-time chat with audio and video calls
meta.description: WacChat: real-time chat with groups, audio and video calls, photos, videos, voice messages and the AI assistant Arno. In 5 languages, also as an app.

hero.title: Chat in real time, hassle-free
hero.subtitle: WacChat It's a messaging app with private and group chats, audio and video calls, photos and videos, and "Arno," an AI assistant that greets you when you first log in.
hero.note: It works in a browser and can be installed as an app on your phone and computer.

features.title: Everything you need to stay in touch

chat.title: Private and Group Chats
chat.text: Message a contact after they've accepted your request, or create groups of up to 50 people with administrator and member roles.

messages.title: Real-Time Messages
messages.text: See when messages have been read, reply to a message, forward it, add reactions, and save important messages.

calls.title: Audio and Video Calls
calls.text: Call a contact or an entire group—up to 8 participants—directly from your browser.

media.title: Photos, videos, and voice messages
media.text: Send pictures, videos, and voice messages up to 50 MB per file.

arno.title: Arno: The AI Assistant
arno.text: Every new user sees "Arno" in the chat: a Gemini-powered assistant they can talk to right away.

app.title: Installable and multilingual
app.text: Install it as an app, receive notifications for messages and calls, and use the interface in Italian, English, French, German, or Spanish.

steps.title: How to Get Started in Three Steps

one.title: Log In
one.text: Sign in with your email address and choose a username.

two.title: Submit a request
two.text: Ask a contact to chat: once they accept, you can message each other.

three.title: Chat and Call
three.text: Write a message, send photos and videos, create a group, or start a call.

about.title: A project born out of passion
about.text: WacChat It was developed by Giuseppe Pio Ruocco as a personal project.
